GENOMA · ESTÉTICA & ODONTOLOGIA — Design System (aprovado pelo Rael, out/2026)

PHOTOGRAPHY
PHOTO REALISM (critical): candid photo shot on an iPhone 15 Pro, natural daylight from a window, no studio lighting, no glow. Unretouched real skin with visible pores, fine peach fuzz, tiny natural imperfections and texture, very light natural makeup, natural flyaway hairs, slight phone-camera grain and natural depth of field. Natural healthy teeth in a natural shade (not artificially white, not perfect veneers). Must look like a real photo posted by a clinic, NOT AI, NOT airbrushed, NOT glossy or plastic.
Frame tight on the face and smile (from nose to chin, or eyes to chin): teeth large and clearly visible, natural healthy shade, bright but never fake veneers.
For whitening/cleaning offers, best scenes: woman holding the shade guide next to her smile; close-up of a professional cleaning (gloved hands, mirror, ultrasonic tip); macro of the shade guide. A dental tooth shade guide (a row of about 12-16 small tooth-shaped porcelain tabs on a grey holder) held right next to the mouth, forming a clear smooth gradient from distinctly yellowish/ivory on the LEFT to very bright clean white on the RIGHT. No brand name written on it.

COMPOSITION
Photo occupies the top 55-70% (or full bleed with a soft veil behind text); text block below on calm background. Feed 4:5: keep every text, button and logo between 6% and 92% of the height and at least 6% from the sides, with text placed on calm areas, never on top of a photo-to-background fade transition.

BACKGROUND
Background has texture and life (soft silk waves, light streaks, linen, subtle sparkle) in the palette colors, softened behind text with a gentle veil so legibility is perfect.

COLOR
Choose one approved palette: branco-dourado (white, ivory, graphite, Gold accents are a soft metallic champagne-gold gradient (#EBD9AE to #CFAE6B to #A9843F) with a subtle luminous sheen.), bege-areia (cream, latte silk waves, chocolate text, caramel), verde (forest green, sage, cream), azul-petroleo (petrol blue, teal light waves, white text, aqua).

TYPOGRAPHY
Headline: elegant thin high-contrast serif mixing roman and italic on the key word (Cormorant/Playfair style). Body: clean light sans (Inter/DM Sans). Labels: small wide letter-spaced caps. Offer text bold in a band, tag or highlighted block.

COPY
Offer always spelled out: "COMBO: Limpeza + Clareamento" and "Condições especiais". Short headline with a twist. Always a call to action ("Agende sua avaliação →"). No result promises.

TEXT
All Portuguese text exactly as written, with correct accents and punctuation, perfectly legible on a phone screen (no text smaller than ~24px at 1080px width). No other text, no logos, no watermarks.
antiPadroes: NEVER generate or retouch a before/after with AI: before/after only with real, authorized patient photos (CFO and Meta rules).
NEVER present an AI-generated person as a patient; models are illustrative.
NEVER promise results ('resultado garantido', 'visível na primeira sessão', 'definitivo').
NEVER use flat yellow as gold; use the metallic champagne-gold gradient.
NEVER put text over the fade between the photo and the background, or closer than 6% to the edges.
NEVER use boxed numbered cards (01/02); show steps with simple typography or a dotted line.
NEVER deliver a piece without a photo or without a call to action.

referencias: foto de iPhone em consultório claro

estilos.descricao: Capa: foto de pessoa à esquerda, painel claro à direita com título serifado e caixa creme na divisa.
estilos.layout: Split layout: the LEFT 55% is a real photo of <pessoa>, photographed in a minimal clinic with warm light, cropped tight on face and shoulder. The RIGHT 45% is a solid soft white panel. On the panel, vertically centered, left-aligned, dark text: large serif roman "<titulo_1>"; large serif italic "<titulo_2_italico>"; light sans-serif "<subtitulo>". Overlapping the boundary between photo and panel near the lower middle, a solid cream box with a very thin dark outline and dark serif text: "<caixa_linha_1>" / "[<caixa_linha_2_colchetes>]" (second line italic inside thin brackets) and small sans "arrasta →".

estilos.descricao: Slide de abertura de tema: 3 perguntas em escada + frase de apoio + colchetes.
estilos.layout: Solid soft white background, no photo. Upper area, three stacked lines in large dark serif italic, staggered left/center/right: "<pergunta_1>" / "<pergunta_2>" / "<pergunta_3>". A short thin hairline. Below, dark light sans-serif, centered: "<apoio>". Below, centered, dark serif italic inside thin accent-colored brackets: "[<colchetes>]".

estilos.nome: Carrossel · Ficha com foto em arco
estilos.descricao: Slide explicativo: numeral grande vazado, título, foto em arco e ficha em 3 linhas.
estilos.layout: Cream background. Top-left: a huge thin outlined serif numeral "<numero>" in the accent color. Next to it, large dark serif "<titulo>" and below in italic "<titulo_italico>". Right side: a tall arch-shaped photo (rounded top) of <foto>. Lower half: a three-row information sheet separated by thin dark hairlines, each row with a small wide-caps label on the left and sans-serif text on the right: "<rotulo_1>" — "<texto_1>"; "<rotulo_2>" — "<texto_2>"; "<rotulo_3>" — "<texto_3_italico>" (this last text in serif italic).

estilos.descricao: Slide explicativo: foto macro de pele em tela cheia + cartão creme com 3 colunas.
estilos.layout: Full-bleed real <foto>. Upper middle, in white: a large thin outlined serif numeral "<numero>" and white serif "<titulo>" / italic "<titulo_italico>". Lower part: a solid cream card spanning most of the width with dark text in three columns separated by thin vertical hairlines: label caps "<rotulo_1>" + sans "<texto_1>"; label "<rotulo_2>" + sans "<texto_2>"; label "<rotulo_3>" + serif italic "<texto_3_italico>".

estilos.descricao: Último slide: foto do ambiente da clínica + caixa creme com CTA.
estilos.layout: Full-bleed real photo of an elegant, minimal clinic reception (light stone wall, oak wood, warm indirect light, vase with dried flowers, no people), slightly darkened. Centered, white large serif: "<titulo_1>" / italic "<titulo_2_italico>". Below, a solid cream box with dark text: sans "<pergunta>", serif italic inside thin brackets "[<cta>]" and small wide caps "LINK NA BIO →".

estilos.descricao: Estático de anúncio: close de rosto em tela cheia com manchete serifada branca e CTA entre colchetes.
estilos.layout: Full-bleed extreme close-up editorial beauty photograph of <pessoa>, natural even skin with real texture, warm soft light. White text centered over the cheek: line 1 roman large "<linha_1>"; line 2 italic large between thin white hairlines "<linha_2_italico>"; line 3 small roman "<linha_3>"; line 4 italic large inside thin square brackets "<linha_4_colchetes>". Below, small wide caps "<cta> →".

estilos.descricao: Estático de anúncio: still life premium (frasco, ampola ou objeto) sobre pedra, com sombra de janela e manchete.
estilos.layout: Premium still-life product photograph: <objeto> standing on a block of warm travertine stone, soft cream backdrop, long elegant window-light shadows with leaf silhouettes falling across the scene, a few drops of water, calm luxury skincare campaign look. Upper area, dark text centered: large serif roman "<manchete>" and large serif italic "<manchete_italico>"; thin hairline; light sans-serif "<apoio>". Lower area, a small solid dark pill with cream text "<cta> →". No brand name on the object.

estilos.descricao: Depoimento real em cartão: aspas grandes, texto do depoimento, iniciais e estrelas. Use SÓ depoimento real e autorizado.
estilos.layout: Cream background with a subtle linen texture and a soft diagonal window-light shadow. Centered: huge thin serif opening quotation mark in the accent color. Below, large dark serif italic text (the testimonial): "<depoimento>". Then a short thin hairline, five small accent-colored stars, small wide caps "<iniciais>" and sans "<procedimento>". Lower area, small dark serif italic inside thin brackets: "[<cta>]".

estilos.descricao: Autoridade da profissional: retrato real (passe a foto com --ref) + credenciais em lista fina.
estilos.layout: Elegant portrait slide. Upper 55%: a real editorial portrait of the professional from the reference image (identical face, keep her appearance exactly), in a white coat or elegant neutral outfit, warm soft light, in a minimal clinic. Lower 45%: soft white panel. On the panel: large dark serif "<nome>"; small wide caps "<titulo_profissional>"; three rows separated by thin hairlines with sans-serif text: "<credencial_1>", "<credencial_2>", "<credencial_3>"; then dark serif italic "<frase_italico>" and small wide caps "<cta> →".

estilos.descricao: Campanha sazonal/oferta: macro de detalhe do rosto (lábios, pele) em tela cheia, selo de campanha em script dourado no topo, pergunta em caixa alta espaçada, manchete grande em dourado metálico, botão contornado e nota pequena.
estilos.layout: Full-bleed, warm, golden-hour editorial beauty macro photograph: extreme close-up of <detalhe>, filling the upper and right side of the frame, soft champagne and nude tones, slightly desaturated, luxurious, shallow depth of field; the lower-left area is softer and darker so text reads well. TOP-LEFT: a campaign seal: tiny sans caps "<selo_pequeno>" above a large metallic gold script/serif "<campanha_1>" and a white serif italic "<campanha_2_italico>" overlapping slightly below it. Under the seal, three short lines of small, very wide letter-spaced white caps: "<pergunta_1>" / bold "<pergunta_2_destaque>" / "<pergunta_3>". LOWER CENTER, centered: a light sans-serif white paragraph "<apoio>"; then a very large thin metallic gold sans-serif headline in caps with a subtle shine: "<manchete>"; below it, small white caps "<procedimento>"; then a thin white outlined rounded pill with small caps "<cta> →"; then tiny white text "<nota>". No other logo. LAYOUT LIMITS: the top of the campaign seal must start below 15% of the image height and the footer must sit above 82% of the height; keep the whole composition compact vertically.

estilos.descricao: Pergunta-gancho dentro de um painel de vidro fosco sobre foto macro de procedimento desfocada no topo; palavra-chave em pílula de cor e palavra final gigante em serifa colorida.
estilos.layout: Full-bleed real photo: <foto>, occupying the lower 55% of the frame and sharp there, while the upper part of the photo is softly out of focus in light grey and neutral tones. Upper-middle area: a large rounded rectangle of frosted glass (subtle translucent white, thin light border), containing centered text: thin clean sans-serif in white "<linha_1>" followed by the word "<palavra_pilula>" in white inside a solid rounded pill in the accent color; next line thin white sans-serif "<linha_2>"; then a very large high-contrast serif word in the accent color "<palavra_gigante>". Below the glass panel, small white caps with a thin arrow "<cta> →".

estilos.descricao: Capa educativa: macro de pele/sorriso em tela cheia, título com primeira linha em serifa itálica e o resto em sans bold, e uma linha pontilhada em onda com 4 pontos de cor e rótulos curtos (processo em etapas). Seta em círculo no canto.
estilos.layout: Full-bleed extreme macro real photograph: <foto>, filling the whole frame, slightly darkened for text contrast. Upper area centered, white text: elegant serif italic "<titulo_italico>" and below in large bold clean sans-serif "<titulo_bold>". Lower half: a thin white dashed line drawn as a smooth wave across the image, with four small solid dots in the accent color placed on the wave (low, high, low, high from left to right); next to each dot a short label in small white sans-serif: "<etapa_1>", "<etapa_2>", "<etapa_3>", "<etapa_4>". Bottom-left: a thin white circle with a thin arrow inside (swipe cue).

estilos.descricao: Close de sorriso em tela cheia com luz quente; cabeçalho e rodapé de revista (nome e especialidade nos cantos); uma palavra gigante em serifa display no meio, frase sublinhada e pergunta numa etiqueta.
estilos.layout: Full-bleed real editorial photograph: <foto>, the smile in the upper half, warm natural tones. Small letter-spaced caps in white at the top-left "<nome_profissional>" and top-right "<especialidade>", repeated identically at the bottom-left and bottom-right like a magazine page (keep these corner labels inside the safe area, never touching the edges). Lower-middle, left-aligned block in a pale cream / light accent color: small sans-serif "<linha_1>" with a thin underline; a huge flowing display serif word "<palavra_gigante>"; a sans-serif line with a thin underline "<linha_2>"; then a small light accent-colored rectangle tag, slightly tilted, with italic sans-serif text "<pergunta>". Below the tag, small letter-spaced caps in white "<cta> →".

estilos.nome: Anúncio · Manchete com cena da clínica
estilos.descricao: Cena real da clínica desfocada (dentista atendendo), linha de credencial no topo e no rodapé, manchete editorial gigante misturando serifa reta e itálica, e frase de apoio em faixas marca-texto.
estilos.layout: Full-bleed real photograph: <foto>; the upper half is softly blurred and light. Top center: small letter-spaced white caps "<credencial>"; the same line repeated near the bottom (both credential lines inside the safe area, never touching the edges). Upper area centered, white text: sans-serif lines "<linha_1>" / "<linha_2>"; then a very large high-contrast display serif headline "<manchete_1>" followed by the same serif in italic "<manchete_2_italico>". Below, two lines of sans-serif text each sitting on a soft translucent highlighter band in a pale accent color: "<apoio_1>" / "<apoio_2>". Below the bands, a small solid white pill with dark text "<cta> →".

estilos.nome: Anúncio · Sorriso com anotações e rodapé
estilos.descricao: Close de rosto/sorriso em tela cheia com setas desenhadas à mão e rótulos curtos apontando detalhes, selo-adesivo da marca, manchete com palavra em bloco de cor + caixa alta em sans bold, e faixa clara de rodapé com contatos.
estilos.layout: Full-bleed close-up real photograph of <pessoa>, cropped tight on the face and smile, filling the upper 85% of the image. PHOTO REALISM (critical): candid photo shot on an iPhone 15 Pro, natural daylight from a window, no studio lighting, no glow. Unretouched real skin with visible pores, fine peach fuzz, tiny natural imperfections and texture, very light natural makeup, natural flyaway hairs, slight phone-camera grain and natural depth of field. Natural healthy teeth in a natural shade (not artificially white, not perfect veneers). Must look like a real photo posted by a clinic, NOT AI, NOT airbrushed, NOT glossy or plastic. Upper-right, at about 16% of the image height (never near the top edge): small white caps "<tagline>". Two thin white hand-drawn curved arrows pointing to details of the smile/skin, each with a short white sans-serif label: "<rotulo_1>" and "<rotulo_2>". Near the cheek: a white die-cut sticker shaped like a soft cloud, slightly rotated, with a small round accent-colored brand dot and dark text "<selo>". Left-middle: the word "<palavra_bloco>" in white inside a solid rectangular accent-colored block, followed by white sans-serif "<linha_1>"; below in very large bold white uppercase sans-serif "<manchete>"; below in light white sans-serif "<apoio>". Bottom: a solid light cream band across the full width (about 13% of the height) with, on the left, two small rounded accent-colored icon squares (a chat bubble and a globe) next to dark text "<contato_1>" and "<contato_2>", and on the right a small solid dark pill "<cta> →".

estilos.descricao: Colagem: pessoa sorrindo em destaque à direita, recortes de sorrisos em cartões arredondados no topo, fundo degradê claro com linha curva sutil, manchete em sans bold, traço de cor, apoio e cartão de CTA com ícones.
estilos.layout: Clean modern collage ad. Background: soft light gradient in the brand's lightest tones with one very subtle large curved line. Right side: real photo of <pessoa>, cut out and placed large, from the chest up, overlapping the other elements. PHOTO REALISM (critical): candid photo shot on an iPhone 15 Pro, natural daylight from a window, no studio lighting, no glow. Unretouched real skin with visible pores, fine peach fuzz, tiny natural imperfections and texture, very light natural makeup, natural flyaway hairs, slight phone-camera grain and natural depth of field. Natural healthy teeth in a natural shade (not artificially white, not perfect veneers). Must look like a real photo posted by a clinic, NOT AI, NOT airbrushed, NOT glossy or plastic. Top: three rounded-corner photo tiles of different sizes, slightly overlapping and partly cropped by the top edge: <detalhe_1>; <detalhe_2>; <detalhe_3>. Left-middle, left-aligned, dark text: a small rounded square icon in the accent color, then very large bold geometric sans-serif "<titulo_negrito>" and regular weight "<titulo_resto>" on two lines; a short thick accent-colored rounded line; light sans-serif "<apoio>". Bottom-right, overlapping the person: a rounded card in the accent color with two small round icon buttons (plus and arrow) on a white tab and text "<cta>!". Bottom-left: small dark text "<rodape>".
